name: Scope Fold
concept: A print-like folded studio brief anchors fixed-price scope in one asymmetric surface while preserving DOM and mobile copy order.
silhouette: one asymmetric paper sheet + large boundary annotation
interaction: The corner fold and scope brackets settle once in view; a small hover response is decorative. All copy is always visible.
safety: The fold is a metaphor, not a contract or payment document. Illustrative qualifiers stay beside both claims.
